name: a put with retire ends the held delete of its keyed record undone, writes only the touched field onto the record, and returns the gesture as retired
writing a fact again inside its delete window is the Undo: the retire ends the held delete, and the whole put writes every field with a fresh life
a whole put after a held delete of its fact, without a retire, out-stamps it: the fact is drawn alive, and both are sent
a retire whose diff is empty still retires the held delete, and the clock ticks
with a minted record the retire returns it to drawn, and an update writes only the touched field
a commit retiring two held gestures returns their gesture ids in commit order
a retire folds a put that carries the retired delete's life, silently, and the retiring put writes over the record as it was
a held gesture carrying a command is not retired: the put makes the record anew
a held gesture with a delta that does not remove is not retired
a held removal of a record the commit does not list is not retired
a released delete, ready, is not retired
a held removal in another scope is not retired
a retiring commit refused cap retires nothing
